commands.command:
set -eu
policy=/etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/90-password-complexity.conf
if [ -e "$policy" ]; then
  printf 'Refusing to overwrite unexpected existing policy: %s\n' "$policy" >&2
  exit 1
fi
umask 022
tmp=$(mktemp /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/.90-password-complexity.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' '# Managed password quality policy: minimum length and character-class diversity' 'minlen = 12' 'minclass = 3' > "$tmp"
chmod 0644 "$tmp"
chown root:root "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$policy"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
restorecon "$policy" 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'installed %s\n' "$policy"
stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G context=%C' "$policy"
sed -n '1,20p' "$policy"
commands.stdout:
installed /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/90-password-complexity.conf
mode=644 owner=root group=root context=system_u:object_r:etc_t:s0
# Managed password quality policy: minimum length and character-class diversity
minlen = 12
minclass = 3

commands.command:
set -u
short="Aa1!$(tr -d '-' </proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid | cut -c1-7)"
two="A$(date +%s%N)"
good="Aa1!$(tr -d '-' </proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid)"
run_reject() {
  label=$1
  candidate=$2
  err=$(mktemp)
  score=$(printf '%s\n' "$candidate" | pwscore 2>"$err")
  rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf 'FAIL %s unexpectedly accepted (length=%s)\n' "$label" "${#candidate}"
    rm -f "$err"
    return 1
  fi
  printf 'PASS %s rejected (length=%s): ' "$label" "${#candidate}"
  tr '\n' ' ' <"$err"
  printf '\n'
  rm -f "$err"
}
run_accept() {
  label=$1
  candidate=$2
  err=$(mktemp)
  score=$(printf '%s\n' "$candidate" | pwscore 2>"$err")
  rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    printf 'FAIL %s rejected (length=%s): ' "$label" "${#candidate}"
    tr '\n' ' ' <"$err"
    printf '\n'
    rm -f "$err"
    return 1
  fi
  printf 'PASS %s accepted (length=%s, score=%s)\n' "$label" "${#candidate}" "$score"
  rm -f "$err"
}
failed=0
run_reject '11-character/four-class candidate' "$short" || failed=1
run_reject 'long/two-class candidate' "$two" || failed=1
run_accept 'long/four-class candidate' "$good" || failed=1
unset short two good
exit "$failed"
commands.stdout:

PASS long/two-class candidate rejected (length=20): Password quality check failed:  The password contains less than 3 character classes 
PASS long/four-class candidate accepted (length=36, score=100)

set -eu

nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; systemctl reboot' >/var/tmp/[REDACTED].log 2>&1 &
printf 'reboot_scheduled node=%s pre_boot_id=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$before"

set -u
i=0
state=unknown
while [ "$i" -lt 25 ]; do
  state=$(systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ "$state" = running ] && break
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 2
done
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state=%s\n' "$state"
printf 'os_release='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s\n' "$PRETTY_NAME"

printf '%s\n' 'persisted_policy:'
stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G context=%C' /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/90-password-complexity.conf
grep -E '^(minlen|minclass)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/90-password-complexity.conf
short="Aa1!$(tr -d '-' </proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid | cut -c1-7)"
two="A$(date +%s%N)"
good="Aa1!$(tr -d '-' </proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid)"
failed=0
check_reject() {
  label=$1
  candidate=$2
  err=$(mktemp)
  score=$(printf '%s\n' "$candidate" | pwscore 2>"$err")
  rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf 'FAIL %s unexpectedly accepted\n' "$label"
    failed=1
  else
    printf 'PASS %s rejected: ' "$label"
    tr '\n' ' ' <"$err"
    printf '\n'
  fi
  rm -f "$err"
}
check_reject '11-character/four-class candidate' "$short"
check_reject 'long/two-class candidate' "$two"
err=$(mktemp)
score=$(printf '%s\n' "$good" | pwscore 2>"$err")
rc=$?
if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf 'PASS long/four-class candidate accepted (score=%s)\n' "$score"
else
  printf 'FAIL long/four-class candidate rejected: '
  tr '\n' ' ' <"$err"
  printf '\n'
  failed=1
fi
rm -f "$err" /var/tmp/[REDACTED].log
unset short two good
[ "$state" = running ] || failed=1
exit "$failed"
